summary:
Round 5 is done, but neither bar was re-measured: the 15-run sweep is the independent engineer's job, and the direction-10 protein targets were not met. All four review findings that blocked or weakened round 4 are fixed. Each has a test that fails without the fix:
- P1, the blocker: the queen's hand-over protein now goes only into the workers' social stomachs. Her carbohydrate goes into the pool as in round 4.
- WL2, the major: the workers the R24 winter loss cap keeps alive now eat through the winter time-lapse.
- M2, the minor: an item inside the nest is never counted as lying at a surface midden.
Ruling R27 is in: a pure helper computes the winter stores need, the life tool's verdict and the sweep table check it, and the autumn carbohydrate target aims for it. App-gate items S3 and S6 (pad prompts during the founding) and S17 (flood alert lines in plain words) are fixed. S7 is not a sim defect: the "unknown" deaths come from the lifecycle script's own cheat.killAll.

On the protein counter (full-length forage bench, 15 hand-overs), P delivered per 30-worker need went from a median of 0.122 to 0.245. The target was 0.3. A 4-run A/B shows the gain comes from P1: once the provision no longer sits in the larder looking like stored protein, foragers start hunting. Protein known within the first game day did not improve (7 of 15 before, 3 of 15 after; target 12).

On life runs to winter, same cached hand-overs, round start vs round end, four runs: workers at winter 36 → 46, eclosions 13 → 36, larvae starved 9 → 2. Carbohydrate at winter covers the R27 need in all four. One run (playground-park #2) now passes the viability bar. The other three still fail the starvation-stage check, with 1.25–2.2 game days of rationing on days 3–6, when pool protein is at zero.

Scouting changes were tried and reverted on the bench numbers: a protein scout floor, and sending all spare outside workers to scout. The scout range change (220 → 300 BU, ruling R18's radius) is kept. Also tried and reverted: holding the queen's carbohydrate as well as her protein, and a longer protein pay-in window.
causesRanked: 1. L1 x R2 hand-over provision (sweep-4 blocker): -26 workers at winter, -21 eclosions, +41 starved larvae over the 15 review pairs; fixed (P1): protein spoiled before the first larva 1.98 -> 0.01 P on car-park-verge #1, 0.84 -> 0.04 by h21 on kitchen-door #1

2. Protein income: P intake/need median 0.045 in sweep 4; on the forage bench 6 of 15 hand-overs know no protein for days (nearest patch edge 118-244 BU); only 20-23 % of chases end in a catch (springtail jump/escape rules in threats-calibrate's folder); the queen's provision in the larder hid the protein need, so foragers did not hunt (P1: bench median P/need 0.122 -> 0.245)

3. Carbohydrate: 4 sweep runs with 0 C at winter; there the R5 winter reserve withheld the queen's laying protein 83-93 % of the time; in carbohydrate-rich runs laying was permitted only 13-14 % of the time, by the protein gates
4. Old age: 56 of 75 adult deaths in year one; follows from 1-3 (R11 stands)
5. Winter stores / R27: check implemented; WL2 corrects spring stores that were overstated by the winter food of the workers the cap kept alive
6. Brood care: egg untended 24, pupa untended 20, egg flooding 24, hygiene 53 (about 24 of the hygiene from L1)
7. Predation 10 and crushed 8 over sweep 4; predation now follows threats-calibrate's ramp

8. Core gaps from threats-calibrate: (a) paralysed nestmates never carried home matters at 60 workers and is about 0 on founding-year colonies; (c) known antlion pits not avoided: no pit exists on the five worlds. Ranked below 1-7, not built this round

next: Protein gap on days 3-6: the first larvae eat the provision and pool protein stays at 0 for 1-2 game days before prey arrives. This is the rationing that fails the stage check in 3 of 4 life runs. Look at when hunting starts and at the larva ration rule
Protein discovery: known within 1 game day in only 3 of 15. More scouts did not help; next try the scout walk's coverage of 50-200 BU, where most patch edges lie, and the carrion odour range
Catch rate: 20-23 % of chases end in a kill (springtail touch jumps and escape rules, threats-calibrate's folder). Ask whether the escape model is the GDD's
Eggs fell on the forage bench (288 -> 225) while larvae starved fell 21 -> 4: check the laying-protein release against the protein the queen still holds
Year two: no long runs this round; the next sweep's five long runs are the first year-two numbers with R27 and WL2
Core gaps (a) paralysed rescue and (c) pit avoidance via locomotion avoidDiscs; S2 waiting foragers; the founding record staying 'reopening' after a pad-played opening

S6: a plugged entrance is offered to the founding queen at class 'self', so her own line wins; reopening (GDD 06 §5.9) stays reachable by cycle-target
